mapper.select: SELECT I.CHECKLIST_ID AS CHECKLIST_ID , I.ITEM_NAME AS ITEM_NAME , I.SEVERITY_CD AS SEVERITY_CD , I.SORT_NO AS SORT_NO , I.ACTIVE_YN AS ACTIVE_YN , NVL(R.CHECKED_YN, 'N') AS CHECKED_YN , R.REMARK AS REMARK FROM TB_IF_CHECKLIST_ITEM_PILOT I LEFT JOIN TB_IF_CHECKLIST_RESULT_PILOT R ON R.CHECKLIST_ID = I.CHECKLIST_ID AND R.TARGET_TYPE = #{targetType} AND R.TARGET_ID = #{targetId} WHERE I.ACTIVE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY I.SORT_NO ASC, I.CHECKLIST_ID ASC
